Role: UCX collision fixer for an AGR VPM OKS delivery. Repo (read rules from it): C:\Users\artsafro\.AGR-DigitalTwin_pilot\.claude\worktrees\erm-maps-diffusers-42de36 . Talk results back in Russian, concise.

Goal: remove all 56 UCX-UCX intersections that SINTEZ AGR Checker 1.6.1 reports ("Проверка коллизий. Пересечения", reg table 2 p.13 pp.4) in this archive, without breaking other passing checks, and analyse each pair: why it intersects and what you changed.

Input (read-only, never overwrite): C:\Users\artsafro\Desktop\!3D viz\Dima_Andrew\3_sreda\itog\Blender\v002\SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A.zip (FBX SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A.fbx + 85 PNG). Objects: SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A_Main (132 001 tris), SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A_MainGlass, 382 UCX_SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A_Main_NNN (6 570 polys). Units metres.
Output: new folder C:\Users\artsafro\Desktop\!3D viz\Dima_Andrew\3_sreda\itog\Blender\v003\ with SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A\ (FBX + same PNGs) and SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A.zip (flat: files at zip root, same names). Edit ONLY UCX objects. Main and MainGlass must stay byte-for-byte equivalent geometry/UV (verify vertex count, tri count, bbox before/after).

Constraints that must keep passing: every UCX closed and convex (SINTEZ "Замкнутость, выпуклость"); total UCX polys <= 6 600 (5% of 132 001 model tris — do not add UCX polys beyond that); UCX naming/numbering unchanged (UCX_SM_Elevatornaya_Vl_1_A_Main_NNN, continuous); gaps between neighbours: project rule D098 is 2 mm – 1 cm gap, SINTEZ also flags too-close < 0.2 mm (D162) — read docs/decisions.md for D098/D162 and src/twinqa/geometry/ucx_audit.py. Also read memory note C:\Users\artsafro\.claude\projects\C--Users-artsafro--AGR-DigitalTwin-pilot\memory\ucx-band-envelope-method.md and grep docs/cases.md / docs/domain for UCX intersection practice (the user says we did this per-pair analysis on the "Олимпийский" object before — look for it, e.g. grep -ri "олимп\|olimp" docs jobs; if nothing, proceed). Collisions must still cover the building (don't just shrink things away from geometry; keep them hugging Main within reason).

Tools: Blender 5.1.2 at "C:/Program Files/Blender Foundation/Blender 5.1/blender.exe" run with -b --factory-startup -P script (bmesh). Use `py -3`, not bare python. FBX export settings that already round-trip through SINTEZ: bpy.ops.export_scene.fbx(filepath=..., use_selection=False, object_types={"MESH","EMPTY"}, apply_unit_scale=True, global_scale=1.0, use_mesh_modifiers=False, mesh_smooth_type="FACE", use_triangles=False, add_leaf_bones=False, bake_anim=False, path_mode="STRIP", embed_textures=False, use_custom_props=False) after a plain bpy.ops.import_scene.fbx of the input. An example of a working edit script is C:\Users\artsafro\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\cf553eeb2ec2497d\0a21d4de-b856-441d-aca7-6f9a100cd31c\scratchpad\fix_v002.py (convex hull rebuild for UCX via a fresh bmesh of welded verts).
Verify with the SINTEZ runner: copy the v003 zip alone into a new empty folder (e.g. under C:\Users\artsafro\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\cf553eeb2ec2497d\0a21d4de-b856-441d-aca7-6f9a100cd31c\scratchpad\ucx_runN\), then from the repo root: `py -3 tools/qa/sintez_checker.py <that_folder> --output <new.json>`; the full log is <new>.checker/AGRChecker_data/checker_log.txt (UTF-8). Baseline v002 result: intersections 56 pairs (e.g. 036–335, 036–340, 039–350, 064–334 ...; full list in the log), convexity OK, UCX count OK. Expected still-failing checks you must ignore: mirrored islands, zero-area UV, pixel density, geojson, signature (УКЭП), naming geojson.

Do not touch the user's open Blender/3ds Max, the input folders, or git. Don't delete files outside your v003/scratch folders.

Report back (Russian): table pair → cause (e.g. overlapping band hulls at corner, hull of 039 after convexification grew into 350–364, duplicated cover, etc.) → fix; final SINTEZ counts for intersections, convexity, UCX polys, gaps; any pair you could not fix and why; absolute path of v003 zip.
